ORDER This writ petition has been filed seeking a direction to the respondents to fix fair and appropriate compensation to acquisition of petitioner's 255 square meter land and house in survey no.631/16,
Maruthoorkurichi Village, Kalkulam Taluk, Kanyakumari District based on petitioners representation dated 15.07.2025 within the time stipulated by this Court.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Deputy Solicitor General for the respondents 3 and 4 and the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the official respondents 1 and 2. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

( Uploaded on: 08/01/2026 06:51:36 pm )
3. Pursuant to the acquisition made of the property of the petitioner, which is in Survey No.631/16,
Maruthoorkurichi
Village, Kalkulam Taluk, Kanyakumari District
, the petitioner submitted a representation on 15.07.2025 for fixing fair compensation.
Pending consideration of the quantum of compensation, an RTI letter was addressed by the petitioner seeking details of the compensation.

According to the letter dated 06.08.2025 issued in pursuance to an RTI application, the compensation was quantified as Rs.23,36,206/-.
4.

The learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents 1 and 2, on instructions, would submit that as on date, the compensation has not been finalized and the proposal is to grant the total compensation of Rs.73,66,466.00/-, which would be the present value in accordance with the Act 3 of 2013.
5. As on date, the compensation has not been finalized.
The said finalization shall be in accordance with the Act 3 of 2013.
Thereafter, any grievance of the petitioner regarding enhancement shall be dealt with only in accordance with the said Act.
Since the compensation has not been finalized till date, the writ petition is premature.
However, it is for https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/01/2026 06:51:36 pm ) the authorities to grant compensation in accordance with the Act and Rules.
With the said observation, the writ petition stands disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
